title: Black car fleet owner asks about Fasttrak
persona: Lorraine Kowalski, 60s, fleet operator in Milwaukee, skeptical and plain-spoken.
goal: Ask if it works with Fasttrak and request a landing airport pickup.
opening_line: I got a car service. We run Fasttrak. Will this work with it or not?

turns.caller: Don't give me a brochure. Yes or no.

branches.if_agent: Says it cannot confirm and offers the team

turns.caller: Let me book one anyway. Landing Sunday at Milwaukee Mitchell.
Take us to 123 Main Street, Wauwatosa.
We need an SUV. Six bags between us.
Who do I talk to about Fasttrak then?

curveballs: Demands yes or no on integration
Asks who to speak with at the end
Large bag count to check capture
expected: Gives an honest non-committal answer about Fasttrak
Captures four passengers and six bags correctly
Offers team callback for software questions
must_not: Say yes to integration without basis
